notes.title: Saint Valentine's Event LIVE
notes.notes:
We've just released a patch which adds Saint Valentine's Event to Idle Bouncer! You can earn special event items by growing your hearts bigger and bigger. These items will apply permanent positive effects to your main game (and event).
Just click the jumping heart at the top-right side and switch to event.
Your main game will progress along with event, so you can switch back and forth if you wish.
Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: Screen Resize And Full Screen Patch
notes.notes: We've just released a patch to enable window re-sizing and full screen option. Full Screen option is available in Settings game menu (NOT ALT+ENTER which is unfortunately hard to fix currently).
